scope: Advertiser suitability for individual content, separate from YPP membership, copyright, Community Guidelines and earnings distributions.

revisions.rule: Certain public-interest coverage, including congressional proceedings and debates over ongoing government actions, may earn advertising revenue under updated hateful/harmful content context guidance.
revisions.limitations: No claim that every political or governmental video is ad-eligible. Specific context and other rules still apply.

revisions.rule: Gaming or scripted depictions of recreational-drug use, sale or promotion may earn ads under revised guidance; non-glorifying educational material and PSAs about drug trafficking may also qualify.
revisions.limitations: Other safety, explicit instructions, glorification, age and contextual restrictions continue; not approval of all drug-related footage.

revisions.rule: Official guidance clarifies graphic gaming scenes in the 8–15-second introduction window can earn ad revenue, whereas content featuring graphic gaming in the first 7 seconds remains ineligible.
revisions.limitations: Do not presume arbitrary gameplay always earns money; titles, thumbnails, gore focus and specific review can restrict ads.

revisions.rule: Clarification addresses context-dependent depictions of death in educational, documentary and news reporting content.
revisions.limitations: Historical event, graphicness, shock, context, and other policy rules can differ; not a blanket clearance for violent videos.

revisions.rule: Young-appearing subjects, human or nonhuman, depicted in distress with graphic/shocking imagery are ineligible for advertising under the clarified shocking content policy.
revisions.limitations: Appearance in a video is not reliable proof that a performer or viewer is a minor; no individual classification is inferred.

revisions.rule: Non-graphic dramatized treatments of controversial issues may earn ad revenue; content focused on child abuse or eating disorders remains subject to limitations on full monetization.
revisions.limitations: Not a promise that discussing any controversial issue earns full ads, or that all educational content is restricted.

status_levels.meaning: Content may earn advertising revenue if all applicable rules pass; not an RPM prediction.
Some content may receive restricted advertisement demand or earnings.
Content does not qualify to earn advertising revenue under the applicable ad suitability policy.
YPP membership, feature-specific modules, and payment account gates remain independently required.
Community Guidelines removal, legal takedown, copyright claims and channel strikes are different processes.

research_rules: Preserve month-level date when official source lacks exact effective day.
Eligibility to earn ads is not guaranteed receipt of revenue or an estimate of typical earnings.
Advertiser suitability, YPP program membership and content takedown have different gates.
Public-interest context and educational/documentary status are not universal exceptions.
Do not infer minors' ages, identities or viewer attributes from video content.
Treat changes as period-specific; never retroactively apply October 2026 standards to older video earnings.
